summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Niu Technologies, a foreign private issuer, reporting its sales volume update for the second quarter of 2026. The filing contains a press release disclosing unit sales of 434,687 total vehicles, a 24% year-over-year increase, with commentary on market performance and product strategy. No special situation such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change is mentioned. The filing is a standard periodic operational update that does not trigger any special-situations classification.
